# Radio

`ui.radio` · parts: `Radio` · elements: `<input>`

## Purpose

Radio is a native input[type=radio]; pair it with Label.

## Notes

<!-- ui8kit-docs:prose:start -->
_No additional notes for Radio yet._
<!-- ui8kit-docs:prose:end -->

Radio renders input[type=radio].

## Variants

## Children

Void / self-contained element: children are not accepted.

## ARIA

- Computed/forwarded: `aria-invalid`, `aria-describedby` (omitted when empty).
- Typed ARIA props: `aria-invalid`, `aria-describedby` — static values only.

| Twig | `ui8kit_classes('radioClasses', { class: '…' })` |
| Latte | `\UI8Kit\Latte\Classes::radioClasses(['class' => '…'])` |
| Jinja2 | `radio_classes(p)` |

## Rendered DOM per state

Canonical renderer output (children = `Content`); all 9 runtimes are parity-tested to produce this DOM.

| State | Props | HTML |
| --- | --- | --- |
| defaults | — | `<input type="radio">` |
| checked | `{"Name":"r","Value":"a","Checked":true}` | `<input type="radio" name="r" value="a" checked>` |
| disabled | `{"Disabled":true,"AriaDescribedBy":"h"}` | `<input type="radio" disabled aria-describedby="h">` |
| Checked | `{"Checked":true}` | `<input type="radio" checked>` |
| Required | `{"Required":true}` | `<input type="radio" required>` |
| Disabled | `{"Disabled":true}` | `<input type="radio" disabled>` |

## Usage

Fixture `checked` (`{"Name":"r","Value":"a","Checked":true}`) — every snippet renders:

```html
<input type="radio" name="r" value="a" checked>
```

**React** ([runtime notes](../runtimes/react.md))

```tsx
import { Radio } from "./ui/radio/radio";

<Radio checked name="r" value="a" />
```

**Vue 3** ([runtime notes](../runtimes/vue.md))

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import Radio from "./ui/radio/Radio.vue";
</script>

<template>
  <Radio checked name="r" value="a" />
</template>
```

**Svelte 5** ([runtime notes](../runtimes/svelte.md))

```svelte
<script lang="ts">
  import Radio from "./ui/radio/Radio.svelte";
</script>

<Radio checked={true} name="r" value="a" />
```

**SolidJS** ([runtime notes](../runtimes/solid.md))

```tsx
import { Radio } from "./ui/radio/radio.solid";

<Radio checked name="r" value="a" />
```

**Web Components** ([runtime notes](../runtimes/webcomponent.md))

```ts
import { renderRadio } from "./ui/radio/radio.wc";

document.body.append(renderRadio({ checked: true, name: "r", value: "a" }));
```

**Go templ** ([runtime notes](../runtimes/templ.md))

```templ
import "github.com/ui8kit/codegen/generated/templ/ui/radio"

@radio.Radio(radio.RadioProps{Name: "r", Value: new("a"), Checked: true})
```

```

**Latte** ([runtime notes](../runtimes/latte.md))

```
